title: Baggage Service Office Card: Delayed Bag Fee Refund Thresholds
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — thresholds for refunding a bag fee when a checked bag is delivered late.** The threshold is a delivery delay in hours and depends on the itinerary and, for an international flight, on the flight's scheduled duration.

| Fare brand | Domestic itinerary (hours) | International flight scheduled up to the long-flight threshold (hours) | International flight scheduled longer than the long-flight threshold (hours) | Long-flight threshold, scheduled duration (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 12 | 15 | 30 | 12 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 12 | 15 | 30 | 12 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 12 | 15 | 30 | 12 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 12 | 15 | 30 | 12 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 12 | 15 | 30 | 12 |
| Crestline First | 12 | 15 | 30 | 12 |

## How the columns are chosen

- Domestic itinerary: the threshold is 12 hours.
- International flight whose scheduled duration is 12 hours or less: the threshold is 15 hours.
- International flight scheduled for longer than 12 hours: the threshold is 30 hours.

The threshold is a delivery delay beyond which the bag fee is refunded; a delay exactly equal to the threshold is not beyond it.

**Hypothetical cases.** A bag delivered 15 hours late after an international flight scheduled at 9 hours is exactly at its 15-hour threshold and is not beyond it; at 16 hours late it is beyond it. After an international flight scheduled at 13 hours, a 20-hour delivery delay is below the 30-hour threshold.
